title: LeadQualifiedSnapshotV1
description: LeadQualified payload v1 (收口③): immutable snapshot taken inside the decide(accept) transaction. company_ref carries green-zone company facts only; contact_refs carry refs + role metadata and MUST NOT embed full_name/email (GDPR minimization — SaaS fetches details by contact_id via the governed API). Consumers dedupe on the envelope event_id.

icp_version.description: icpDefinition.version at decide time; null if the ICP row is gone.

contact_refs.description: Refs + role metadata only. full_name/email are intentionally NOT representable (additionalProperties:false).

demand_proof.description: Demand evidence dimension (since 收口⑤, sourced from first-class signals: tender published / supplier sourcing opened). null = lead scored before rule 'additive-6dim-v2'. Observational: not part of total until the multiplicative gate ships (R2 backtest).

qualification_rule_version.description: Scoring rule set this lead was actually scored with, read from the lead's score_detail.ruleVersion (recorded at scoring time since additive-6dim-v3), not the producer's current rules. A lead scored before v3 and not re-scored since carries additive-6dim-v2; a lead that was never scored carries null. additive-6dim-v3 (2026-10-14): reachability = max(company-level contact paths, personal contact points); weights fit .45 / role 0 / intent .15 / data_quality .15 / reachability .20 / engagement .05; same six keys and ranges as v2, so snapshot_version stays 1.

storage_rights_decision.description: DataRightsService STORE-action verdict (ALLOW | ALLOW_WITH_BASIS | REQUIRE_APPROVAL | DENY); null if the producer did not evaluate rights.

valid_until.description: Earliest expiry of the facts backing this lead = min(evidence.fetchedAt + per-class TTL, latest intent event.at + timing window). null when no freshness basis (no evidence, no intent). Past value => backing data already stale, re-qualify before outreach.

sanctions_screening.description: Fifth-gate sanctions screening verdict (OFAC/EU). 'hold' matches never reach a delivered snapshot — decide(accept) throws SANCTIONS_HOLD_UNRESOLVED. 'not_screened' means the gate is DISABLED; SaaS MUST NOT do outreach on a not_screened package.

list_versions.description: sourceKey -> list publish date (ISO), e.g. { ofac_sdn: '2026-07-13' }.

scored_at.description: When the scoring stage last wrote the six-dimension scores (lead.scored_at). null = never scored (the queue was the fit gate's preset) or scored before the column existed. Optional since 2026-10-14; absent in older payloads.

queue_basis.description: What decided the queue the lead sat in when it was accepted: the fit gate's preset (never scored), the scoring stage, or a human decision. Optional since 2026-10-14; absent in older payloads.

company_profile.description: BI-19 delivery facts (design 2026-10-10 §3): the company's website-profile facts, green data only. Optional since 2026-10-27; absent in older payloads.

trade_role.description: distributor | wholesaler | manufacturer | mixed | service | other

identifiers_ext.description: BI-19: register and VAT identifiers extracted from the Impressum. Optional; absent in older payloads.

register_key.description: Court-qualified German register key, e.g. de-hrb:muenchen:98765

company_contact_points.description: BI-14 company-level contact links (green, https, no query/fragment, no personal data). Optional; absent in older payloads.

suggested_contact_path.description: BI-15 deterministic contact path (supplier page > contact form > contact page > Impressum). Optional; null when no path qualifies.

signals.description: Up to three newest public intent signals backing 'why now'. Optional; absent in older payloads.

evidence_urls.description: URLs of the field evidence backing this snapshot, each with its field and fetch time. Optional; absent in older payloads.

fit_reason_codes.description: BI-20 deterministic fit reason codes (FIT_MATCH / FIT_WEAK / FIT_MISMATCH, RULE_<kind>_FAIL, MISSING_<field>, MISSING_CONTACT_POINT, SANCTIONS_HOLD). Optional; absent in older payloads.
